core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghayth is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Rain”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghayth corresponds to the Arabic form غيث (Arabic root غ ي ث (gh-y-th); غيث (Ghayth)). Its core sense is rain, succour, relief. Ghayth (غيث) is an Arabic male name meaning 'rain' and 'succour, relief'. The source gloss 'intense rain' is a fair rendering. Same name as ghaith and ghais.

persian.name: غيث
